info.name: Uxio TopUp API v2
info.description:
Complete collection for the Uxio Web TopUp API (v2 — regenerated 2026-07-09).

Response envelope: `{ "status": "success|fail|error", "code": <int>, "message": "...", "data": ... }`

Auth: run **Auth → Login** first — the test script stores `data.access_token` into `{{token}}` (collection-level Bearer auth) and `data.refresh_token` into `{{refresh_token}}`.

Rate limits: global API 120/min, checkout & postpaid 10/min, webhooks 120/min per IP, login 5/min per IP. Checkout/pay-bill also enforce a 15-second duplicate-submit guard.

Status enums: Transaction = PENDING/PAID/PROCESSING/COMPLETED/FAILED_PROVIDER/EXPIRED/REFUNDED; Payment = '1' Pending / '2' Expired / '3' Success / '4' Refunded.

request.description: Throttled 5/min per IP. Captures access_token → {{token}} and refresh_token → {{refresh_token}}.

exec: console.warn('Login succeeded but no token found in res.data.access_token');

request.description: Exchanges the 30-day refresh token for a fresh 60-minute access token.

item.name: Checkout (Public)

request.description: Authenticated checkout — price resolved by role (vip/reseller/agent/member). Balance channel deducts wallet and fulfils synchronously.
Guest checkout — guest_contact (WhatsApp) is required; guests always pay price_member.

item.description: Throttled 10/min per user/IP. An identical checkout within 15 seconds is rejected as a duplicate submit (HTTP 400 "Permintaan duplikat terdeteksi").

item.name: Digiflazz Postpaid (Public)

request.description: Inquires the outstanding bill from Digiflazz (cek tagihan).
Bill amount is re-inquired server-side; margin = supplier commission.

item.description: Throttled 10/min (shares the checkout limiter). Same 15s duplicate-submit guard as checkout.

request.description: Queries the Digiflazz deposit balance (cek saldo).
Re-queries Digiflazz for a PROCESSING transaction (duplicate ref_id acts as a status check).

type: prepaid | pasca (defaults to prepaid). Pulls the Digiflazz price list, updates supplier costs/availability, recalculates auto-priced selling prices via pricing rules, auto-creates new SKUs as INACTIVE products, and returns a report: {type, total_fetched, price_changed, new_products[], deactivated[], reactivated[], negative_margin[], unmapped_brands[], skipped_skus[]}. Also runs daily at 04:30 via the scheduler (digiflazz:sync-products --type=all).

item.name: Pricing Rules
item.description: Markup rules used by the daily Digiflazz sync to compute selling prices from supplier cost. role: member|vip|reseller|agent. category_id null = global fallback rule; a category-specific rule overrides the global one. price = ceil(cost × (1 + markup_percent/100)) + markup_flat. One rule per (category, role) — duplicates are rejected 422.

request.description: Filters: search, role_id, min/max_balance, min/max_point, is_email_verified, date_from/to, per_page.

item.name: Categories
item.description: logo is an optional image upload — switch the body to form-data when sending one.

item.name: Sub-Categories

request.description: multipart/form-data — includes a file upload field.

item.description: Create requires a logo image (multipart). Update logo is optional (JSON body shown).

item.name: Products
item.description: auto_price (update only, optional): true = daily Digiflazz sync recalculates selling prices from supplier cost via pricing rules; false = prices are manual and the sync leaves them alone.

item.name: Supplier Products
item.description: Maps a product to a supplier SKU. Only ONE active mapping per product is used at checkout. The daily sync updates price/availability on the (supplier_id, buyer_sku_code) unique key.

item.name: Transactions
item.description: status enum: PENDING | PAID | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | FAILED_PROVIDER | EXPIRED | REFUNDED. Index supports ?status= and ?search= filters.

item.name: Payments
item.description: status codes (string): '1' Pending, '2' Expired/Failed, '3' Success, '4' Refunded.

item.name: Banners

request.description: multipart/form-data — includes a file upload field.

item.description: Create requires an image (multipart). Update image is optional (JSON body shown).

item.name: Announcements
item.description: image_path is an optional image upload — switch to form-data when sending one.

item.name: Monetapay Admin
item.description: Outbound signed calls to Monetapay (app_id/sign injected server-side). Numbers reference the Monetapay API spec sections. Requires auth.

item.name: _Webhooks (Reference Only)
item.description: Reference only — these are called BY the payment gateway/supplier, not by clients. Monetapay callbacks carry an AES-encrypted en_data payload with a Double-MD5 signature; Digiflazz callbacks are HMAC-SHA1 signed (X-Hub-Signature) over the raw body. Unsigned requests are rejected. Throttled 120/min per IP.
